boundary.coordinatesHint: One corner per line, for example -55.721534, -12.545812. The drawing and this list stay in sync.
boundary.drawingHint: Click the map to add each corner. Click the first corner, or press Enter, to close the shape. Esc cancels.
boundary.editHint: Drag a corner to move it, drag a midpoint to add a corner, or right-click a corner to delete it.
boundary.noArea: No boundary yet. Draw it on the map or type the corners below.

problem.format: Each line needs a longitude and a latitude separated by a comma.
problem.range: Longitude must be between -180 and 180 and latitude between -90 and 90.
problem.tooFew: A boundary needs at least three corners.
